(() => { const base = 'https://www.theasianbeauty.com'; const clean = (v) => String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(v, location.href || base).href; } catch (e) { return v || ''; } }; const pick = (img) => { if (!img) return ''; const src = img.getAttribute('src') || img.getAttribute('data-src') || img.getAttribute('data-original') || ''; const url = abs(src); if (!/cdn\.theasianbeauty\.com\/media\//i.test(url)) return ''; if (/\/small_|\/thumbnail_/i.test(url)) return ''; return url; }; const title = clean(document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent || document.title).replace(/^Asian Beauty Hub\s*\|\s*/i, ''); let cover = ''; const imgs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('img[src*="cdn.theasianbeauty.com/media/"][alt*="photo"]')); for (let i = 0; i < imgs.length; i++) { cover = pick(imgs[i]); if (cover) break; } if (!cover) cover = pick(document.querySelector('img[src*="cdn.theasianbeauty.com/media/"]')); const desc = clean(document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]')?.getAttribute('content') || ''); const country = clean(document.querySelector('a[href="/south_korea"], a[href="/japan"], a[href="/taiwan"], a[href="/vietnam"], a[href="/malaysia"], a[href="/thailand"]')?.textContent || ''); return JSON.stringify({ title, cover, author: country, status: 'completed', description: desc, genre: country }); })();

(() => { const base = 'https://www.theasianbeauty.com'; const pages = []; const seen = []; const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(v, location.href || base).href; } catch (e) { return v || ''; } }; const push = (v) => { if (!v || /^data:/i.test(v)) return; const url = abs(v); if (!/cdn\.theasianbeauty\.com\/media\//i.test(url)) return; if (/\/small_|\/thumbnail_/i.test(url)) return; if (seen.indexOf(url) >= 0) return; seen.push(url); pages.push({ index: pages.length, url, imageUrl: url }); }; document.querySelectorAll('img[src*="cdn.theasianbeauty.com/media/"][alt*="photo"]').forEach((img) => push(img.getAttribute('src') || img.getAttribute('data-src') || img.getAttribute('data-original') || '')); return JSON.stringify(pages); })();
